load_boundary: DOE P_e_nonplant_kW + P_e_unresolved_kW; fans_kW already included in P_e_nonplant_kW

fan.accounting: fan_incremental_electric_kW=(fan_ratio-1)*fans_kW; fan_ratio is a scenario parameter, not validated ventilation/room pressure

oxygen_psa.source: H. Si et al., Chemical Engineering Journal 509 (2025) 161273, Table 7, PSA 4-bed 6-step, approximately 92% O2, not universal medical PSA
oxygen_psa.production_profile_Nm3_per_h: User-provided fixed example or CSV; no real hospital data supplied

thermal_1R1C.thermal_capacity_method: Zone air thermal capacity + assumed fraction of InternalMass furniture construction heat capacity parsed from supplied San Diego IDF
thermal_1R1C.geometry_method: IDF zone volume divided by zone ceiling height; unit zone without multiplier
thermal_1R1C.parameter_status: Illustrative; requires calibration or sensitivity analysis before quantitatively assessing medical outage risk
thermal_1R1C.response_method: Analytical hourly exact 1R1C disturbance on EnergyPlus base-case zone air temperature with sensible cooling interruption; not feedback to original MILP
